erg2024.notes: Corrosive & toxic inhalation hazard (TIH); water fog/spray on vapor cloud, do NOT apply water directly into liquid spill.
Heavy greenish-yellow TIH gas; settles in low river valleys; shelter-in-place with HVAC shutoff when evacuation would cross plume.
Polar solvent — requires Alcohol-Resistant Aqueous Film-Forming Foam (AR-AFFF); tank car in fire: isolate 0.5 mile (800 m) in all directions.
BLEVE hazard if tank car/vessel exposed to flame; isolate 1 mile (1600 m) in all directions if tank is involved in fire.

wvStatutesAndDoctrine.topic: Governor's State of Emergency & Preparedness Proclamation
wvStatutesAndDoctrine.rule: Authorizes Governor (or Legislature by concurrent resolution) to proclaim a state of emergency; activates emergency powers and state EOP.

wvStatutesAndDoctrine.topic: Local Emergency Organization & Mutual Aid Arrangements
wvStatutesAndDoctrine.rule: Authorizes county/municipal emergency services directors and reciprocal intrastate mutual aid across West Virginia political subdivisions.
Governs interstate mutual aid requests, credential reciprocity, tort liability, and reimbursement through WVEMD.

wvStatutesAndDoctrine.cite: WV HB 5638 / WVOT Cyber Incident Protocol
wvStatutesAndDoctrine.rule: Requires immediate isolation of compromised OT/IT segments, preservation of forensic logs, and coordination with WVOT CISO / WV Fusion Center—prohibits unapproved ransom payments.
EMPG recipients must maintain a progressive HSEEP exercise program and submit a completed After-Action Report / Improvement Plan (AAR/IP) within 90 calendar days.

T&M contracts are restricted to a reasonable initial emergency window (typically <= 70 hours under FEMA PA guidance), require a strict dollar ceiling, and require independent load/scale/monitor verification.
